items.title: Clayton Duerr Interview, 1972-04-17
items.q: Do you remember any of the tunes that you recorded with Wayne? ... Downstream is the only one I remember. ... we made six sides.

ctx.x: How long before you started work with Wayne Eaton?

Oh, I don't know, it wasn't too long. I think it was just a few days after I met there or something like that. It was an old famous store. You see, the old famous store was on the, what we call the uptown side of 57th Street. When they opened the new famous store was on the downtown side. You know what I mean? Yeah. You know what I mean? You remember? You remember that? You remember New York? You know what I mean? I wasn't there. No, but I mean, but I've been in New York. You were in New York.
